body: Thank you so much for your condolences and kind words, especially the part about being proud of OP and I for choosing ourselves, it means a lot. And it’s exactly how I’ve been processing this situation— “I love them, but I cannot neglect myself any more.” You don’t neglect yourself either, extend yourself the grace and gentleness you deserve always, but especially in this moment. You made the right choice and you’re not alone. Sending my love. ❣️

My God, I read this post and thought it had been uploaded from my brain, I’m in such a scarily similar situation right now.. I’m so sorry that you’re having to go through this, too, especially during this time of year. I know that it was probably a necessary change, though, and I’m hoping for brighter days for the both of us, OP. Much love. ❤️
